in_marathi.name: Janavi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Janavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Janavi is derived from the Sanskrit root 'jan' which means 'to be born'. The name Janavi is a compound of two words - 'Jan' meaning 'born' and 'Ve' meaning 'grace'. This name signifies the grace and beauty that comes with being born.
